limitations: Axe cannot decide whether the text equivalent is complete or the translations are accurate.
The SVG is an atomic image; the complete equivalent is the node table and the linear explanation.
The prototype has one small inline script for keyboard scrolling; all content remains in HTML and is readable without it.
